units.source_text: 然而，一天早晨，同规定的配给品一起，送来一份漫画杂志。

en.t: However, one morning, along with the usual rations, a comic magazine was delivered.

units.source_text: 不，漫画杂志本身并没有什么可说三道四的。

en.t: No, there was nothing in particular to criticize about the comic magazine itself.

units.source_text: 封面破破烂烂，脏兮兮，邋里邋遢的，

en.t: Its cover was tattered, grimy, and slovenly-looking,

units.source_text: 恐怕是从废品回收站收购来的，除了不干净这一点以外，

en.t: probably bought from a scrap collection station, and apart from being filthy,

units.source_text: 是呵，可以说是村子里的家伙们能够想出的赏赐。

en.t: yes, it could be called the sort of reward the villagers were capable of coming up with.

units.source_text: 问题是拿来一看，竟然让他两手捶地，笑得直不起腰来，

en.t: The trouble was that when he picked it up and looked at it, it made him pound the ground with both hands and laugh so hard he could not straighten up,

units.source_text: 甚至连胃也像要痉挛起来。

en.t: until even his stomach seemed about to go into spasms.
